title: Work well, but…
text: Work well, but…. No older or even modern closet is set up for these hanging rods.  To really have something going, we would have to remove the shelf all closets seem to have, and raise the existing rod at least a foot higher.  Using it on the existing rod leaves clothes dragging on the floor.  So, yes, these are well-made and easy to install, and may work well for more modern closets - just not for ours!  Nothing wrong with the product, though.
